findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "predictive-analytics" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: predictive-analytics_cox-regression, predictive-analytics_rfm-segment · Public sink: predictive-analytics_kmeans-cluster, predictive-analytics_dbscan-cluster, predictive-analytics_pca, predictive-analytics_decision-tree-train, predictive-analytics_random-forest-importance, predictive-analytics_kaplan-meier-survival, predictive-analytics_cox-regression, predictive-analytics_cohort-retention, predictive-analytics_rfm-segment, predictive-analytics_clv-bg-nbd, predictive-analytics_market-basket-rules, predictive-analytics_changepoint-detect, predictive-analytics_classification-metrics, predictive-analytics_correlation-analysis, predictive-analytics_propensity-score-match · Destructive: predictive-analytics_kmeans-cluster, predictive-analytics_dbscan-cluster, predictive-analytics_pca, predictive-analytics_decision-tree-train, predictive-analytics_random-forest-importance, predictive-analytics_kaplan-meier-survival, predictive-analytics_cox-regression, predictive-analytics_cohort-retention, predictive-analytics_rfm-segment, predictive-analytics_clv-bg-nbd, predictive-analytics_market-basket-rules, predictive-analytics_changepoint-detect, predictive-analytics_classification-metrics, predictive-analytics_correlation-analysis, predictive-analytics_propensity-score-match.
